about_the_game:
In the country of Milago exists a place called New Cesada, a small but extremely quickly developing city that has been experiencing disappearances for the last 30 years.

In this top-down perspective rpg-esque adventure you'll come across various simple puzzles that will impede your way, characters who may help your way and bad apples who will chase you down to the end of the earth. As you explore the Igneferia, a mini-mall that will be permanently closing and won't be seeing anyone else entering in a month, and reach new floors you will become closer to your goal.

You play as Faron, a young art student who got trapped inside the mini-mall. You will meet locals such as Starr, an imp who knows the ins and outs of the city and Zerca, an ex-journalist who has been investigating the innumerable amount of disappearances.

Speak to them! Know more about them and learn their own goals by speaking to them at each new save point.
Or if you are alone, speak to yourself, who knows? It may put your thoughts in order.

Try to find your way out, learn about the secrets of this town and may fortune be on your side.
